name: environment-register
title: Feature flag ownership register
for_each: select id,name from environments order by name

sections.title: Environment
sections.sql: select name,owner,revision from environments where id=$1

sections.title: Active flags
sections.sql: select key,owner,purpose,review_on from flag_register where environment_id=$1 and key in (select jsonb_object_keys(document->'f') from environments where id=$1) order by key
sections.note: Private operator record. Reconcile with the deployed application separately.

sections.title: Release history
sections.sql: select revision,actor,reason,created_at from releases where environment_id=$1 order by revision desc

name: release-handover
title: Release handover
for_each: select id,code from changes order by code

sections.title: Test evidence
sections.sql: select actor,passed,results,created_at from checks where change_id=$1 order by created_at

sections.title: Review decisions
sections.sql: select actor,decision,evidence,created_at from decisions where change_id=$1 order by created_at
sections.note: Named actors are supplied text, not authenticated signatures. This document does not prove deployment.
